prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Audit a Mac searchable people directory. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. Search field has no label or placeholder, Clear deletes directory records, submitting closes the window, a query returning zero results leaves stale matches and the scope indicator says All while only searching favorites.

criteria.task_completion: Find these five search-field defects and specify labelled query entry, safe clearing, proper results/empty state and accurate scope with keyboard operation.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the search-fields guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find these five search-field defects and specify labelled query entry, safe clearing, proper results/empty state and accurate scope with keyboard operation.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find these five search-field defects and specify labelled query entry, safe clearing, proper results/empty state and accurate scope with keyboard operation.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Query field lacks an explanation of searchable content.
Clear performs data destruction instead of clearing query text.
Search submission unexpectedly closes the task window.
Zero-result query leaves stale unrelated matches visible.
Displayed scope disagrees with actual favorites-only search.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
